summary: Bump the release version to 0.2.5 so the Core agent credential-offer fix (BUG-0189) and the SMB/NFS reliability fixes found in native lab testing (BUG-0190 remote mount retry, BUG-0191 exclusive disk check with an unmounted repository, BUG-0192 stuck shared VM update settling and blast radius) reach hosts; 0.2.4 is already tagged and published. API impact: none for the version bump itself; the fixes carry their own change records.

guide.reason: Release version and notes only; the fixes that change operator behaviour update the guide in their own change records.

api.reason: API impact: none. Release metadata only; no Controller, Core or client contract changes.

roadmap.reason: Patch release; no milestone or acceptance gate change.

state.reason: No durable state; the version is derived from the git tag and the newest CHANGELOG heading.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_release_version.py' (newest heading resolves to 0.2.5); python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; privacy unittest. Tagging, building and publishing are left to the project owner.
